headline: Knicks 4-1: 53 years, Brunson 45, a 29-point Game 4
whyCareReason: New York's first title since 1973. Jalen Brunson Finals MVP. Game 5 in San Antonio, 94-90, 45 points.
teaser: Knicks beat the Spurs 4-1, 3-13 June. Game 4: 107-106 from 29 down, OG Anunoby 1.2 seconds. Game 5: Brunson 45 on the road.
story:
Why this one matters: 53 years is long enough that people in the building had never seen the last one. The Knicks beat the San Antonio Spurs 4-1 in June and the city remembered how to throw a parade.

The series, from Wikipedia and NBA.com: Game 1 Knicks 105-95 in San Antonio. Game 2 Knicks 105-104. Game 3 Spurs 115-111 at MSG. Game 4 Knicks 107-106, largest Finals comeback on record, 29 points, Anunoby tip-in with 1.2 seconds left. Game 5 Knicks 94-90 in San Antonio, Brunson 45, tying Michael Jordan for most points on the road in a series-clinching Finals game.

Mike Brown's Knicks. Mitch Johnson's Spurs, who had just beaten Oklahoma City 4-3 in the West. First Finals since 1995 in which a team won two straight road games to open. First since 1993 in which the road team won the first three.
stakes: A city that had waited since 1973.
rivalryAngle: New York versus the Spurs' new era, Wembanyama's first Finals trip ending in five.
